author: KomodoLord1
body:
My Age:12
Discord ID: #9970 or KomodoLord1
I will be very active and passionate about being a builder
My attributes to being a builder is coming up with new ideas and putting in the hard work like the decoration and I can use World-Edit very well and I also like to help others with there map if they are stuck or need help


You need to have a new map that will leave fresh ideas with the community and is also honed for great, fun PvP and Bow gameplay for the players of Avicus. Another very important thing is making improvements to your map if it gets denied, I think you should never really give up on a map until it is accepted and make all the necessary improvements to your map.
I don't know much at all about XML but if needed could learn a little about it as I really want to learn how to create XML's for maps.
As a builder I would mainly be focusing on creating new and fun maps, however will grow and learn and maybe one day create a full XML.


1. https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/5b5897cf2?page=1#reply365150 The first version
2. https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/3d39fa64e The revamped version of the first waiting to be accepted/denied
    I have had a lot of past experience in helping others on there maps which then went on to be accepted and denied

I want to be a builder as it is the thing I am best at on MC and it makes me so happy to listen to some music and make a new map with friends, and when I see my map denied it makes me even happier knowing that I can learn from my mistakes. I also want to make the players on Avicus excited to see new maps that give them a chance to have loads of fun and new PvP experiences.
I will help the Map-Developer by giving them new and cool ideas that could make cool innovative maps that players on Avicus would just love .

By KomodoLord1

(PS I LOVE AVICUS)

title: KomodoLord1's Builder Application

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Hello,

We have decided to deny your application for the following reason(s):

- We want to see you become more active with map related content (give feedback for maps on the forums, build maps, etc). Once improved on this, you should apply for when the applications next open.

Good luck and thanks for applying!
